archetypes.name: Vertical AI agent for a paper-heavy operational job in a traditional European B2B industry
archetypes.test: freight forwarding, customs, insurance claims/underwriting, accounting/tax, construction logistics, medtech/pharma compliance, energy back-office — founder can name the role being replaced

archetypes.name: Cross-border industrial trade or procurement platform for a fragmented physical commodity, with embedded financing, logistics or pricing intelligence
archetypes.test: metals, chemicals, fertiliser, packaging, industrial parts, building materials

archetypes.name: "Regulated-by-design" financial infrastructure
archetypes.test: stablecoin/e-money under MiCA/FCA, B2B payment rails with credit, SME working capital in a vertical, non-dilutive financing

archetypes.name: Insurance infrastructure for new or under-served commercial risks
archetypes.test: MGAs, AI underwriting/inspection, cyber/climate/fleet risk data

archetypes.name: Defence software layer
archetypes.test: sensor fusion, C2/C4ISR integration, resupply/logistics planning, training & simulation, EW/data — software-defined, legacy-compatible, European/NATO customers, dual-use path

archetypes.name: Dual-use autonomous platforms with a fleet/software brain
archetypes.test: UGV, UAV, maritime, counter-drone from teams with defence access AND a commercial market

archetypes.name: Industrial autonomy software for manufacturing
archetypes.test: PLC/automation-logic AI, adaptive robot control, predictive maintenance, MRO/spare-parts optimisation, digital twins for old plants

archetypes.name: Energy & critical-infrastructure intelligence
archetypes.test: industrial energy procurement/PPA optimisation, EV-charging settlement/clearing, grid-asset software, geothermal/critical minerals with a sovereignty story

archetypes.name: Decarbonisation compliance data infrastructure
archetypes.test: CBAM, product carbon certificates, Scope 3 in agri/steel/chemicals — where an EU regulation creates a mandatory buyer

archetypes.name: Sovereign compute / chips / photonics / secure infrastructure
archetypes.test: Frontier, only with world-class technical founders and an 'Europe cannot depend on X' narrative

archetypes.name: Agent-infrastructure with a sharp wedge from repeat/technical founders
archetypes.test: evaluation, fine-tuning, orchestration, domain-specific small models — London/Nordics-heavy

archetypes.name: Workforce & skills platforms for physical industries with labour shortages
archetypes.test: installers, technicians, defence/industrial hiring, workforce in hard regions

archetypes.name: Studio-style pre-company duos
archetypes.test: a domain insider + engineer with a thesis in archetypes 1–9, no company yet, ideally Munich/Berlin/London — Project A Studio candidates

archetypes.name: Sovereignty-framed bio-manufacturing / materials
archetypes.test: bio-fermented ingredients, alternative feedstocks, new materials — rare; needs exceptional team

archetypes.name: OUTLIER / NEW FRONTIER (no portfolio twin required)
archetypes.test: exceptional founders + huge market + powerful why-now + genuine differentiation + early — no theme required; scored through the outlier route

conflict.complementary: Complementary to a portfolio company (+, intro reason)
conflict.potential_conflict: POTENTIAL PORTFOLIO CONFLICT — do not forward until Omar/Project A confirms whether it is investable
conflict.unclear: Conflict unclear — verify with Omar before forwarding

founder: Domain insider OR strong technical founder
Repeat founder / prior exit + technical depth, or world-class technical team
insight: Proprietary distribution, data or regulatory access
Hard-won insight a generalist could not have
taste: Outside Project A's taste (consumer, generic SaaS, services)
Fits a theme and the underlying taste (B2B, structural moat)
Squarely inside a theme, textbook example
venture_scale: Niche — hard to see a €300M+ outcome
Large/expanding market, wedge can grow into a platform
Huge market, clear platform expansion, Europe→global path
why_now: No credible reason it must exist now
Clear structural driver (regulation, capability step, labour shortage)
Powerful, dated driver (hard deadline, geopolitical shift, cost curve crossed)

penalties.known: Already known to every VC / late
